Working notes:

- Campaign has run 10 pushes, generally at the usual 10am window.
- Latest pooled result: 5 of the last 10 pushes landed (+0.50). There is no per-day or per-angle breakdown, so do not infer that quality stories or testimonials outperform other angles.
- Angle mix to date: quality story (B) was used most often; customer testimonial (D) was also used repeatedly. Price cut (A) and limited-time urgency (C) were not selected.
- Continue rotating angles or deliberately balance them to obtain comparable data. Prefer trust-building messaging (quality stories and genuine testimonials) over discounts or artificial urgency, but treat this as a strategic preference—not evidence of superior performance.
- No deliverability complaints were reported on relevant days. Legal approved all four angles.
- The list grew by a handful of signups on several days, but the source of growth is unknown; do not attribute it to a particular tactic.
- Two unsubscribes arrived through support on Day 1 and were processed.
- Track future results by day, angle, send time, landing/delivery, conversions, and unsubscribes so pooled performance can be diagnosed.

Working notes:

- Campaign has run 20 pushes, generally at the usual 10am window.
- Latest pooled result: 5 of the last 10 pushes landed (+0.50). No per-day, angle, delivery, conversion, or unsubscribe breakdown is available, so performance cannot be diagnosed or attributed.
- Days 11–20 all used customer testimonial (D), despite earlier guidance to rotate angles. This provides no valid comparison and does not establish that testimonials outperform other angles.
- Overall angle mix remains heavily concentrated on quality stories (B) and testimonials (D); price cut (A) and limited-time urgency (C) have not been tested. Deliberately balance future sends to obtain comparable data.
- Trust-building messaging (B/D) remains a strategic preference, not an evidence-based performance conclusion. Avoid treating testimonial selection as validated.
- Legal has approved all four angles. No deliverability complaints were reported on relevant days.
- Several days had a handful of new signups, but their source is unknown; do not attribute growth to any tactic.
- Multiple pairs of unsubscribes arrived through support and were processed. Record them by date; do not infer causation without send-level data.
- Track every future send by date, angle, send time, delivered/landed status, conversions, and unsubscribes. Ensure the actual selected angle is recorded accurately; recent logs consistently show D.

Working notes:

- Campaign has run 30 pushes, generally at the usual 10am window.
- Latest pooled result: 8 of the last 10 pushes landed (+0.80). No per-day angle, delivery, conversion, or unsubscribe breakdown is available, so performance cannot be diagnosed or attributed.
- Days 11–20 used customer testimonial (D); days 21–30 used price cut (A). These consecutive blocks do not provide a controlled or balanced angle comparison. The improved pooled result does not establish that A outperforms D or any other angle.
- Quality story (B) and urgency (C) remain under-tested. Future sends should rotate or balance all four angles, recording the actual selected angle accurately.
- Trust-building messaging (B/D) remains a strategic preference, not an evidence-based performance conclusion.
- Legal has approved all four angles. No deliverability complaints were reported on relevant days.
- A banner refresh occurred on Day 25; isolate this creative change when interpreting results if possible.
- Several days had a handful of new signups, but their source is unknown; do not attribute growth to any tactic.
- Support processed multiple pairs of unsubscribes. Record each by date and send; do not infer causation without send-level data.
- For every future send, record date, angle, send time, delivered/landed status, conversions, unsubscribes, creative/version changes, and relevant list changes. Ensure pooled reports retain per-send detail.

Working notes:

- Campaign has run 40 pushes, generally at the usual 10am window.
- Latest pooled result: 2 of the last 10 pushes landed (+0.20), down from the prior 8 of 10. No per-day delivery, angle, conversion, or unsubscribe breakdown is available, so the decline cannot be diagnosed or attributed.
- Days 11–20 used testimonial (D); days 21–30 used price cut (A), so that comparison was unbalanced. Days 31–40 all used quality story (B), but pooled results still do not establish B’s effectiveness because send-level outcomes are unavailable.
- Quality story (B) is now more exercised, but remains unproven. Urgency (C) remains under-tested. Future sends should rotate or balance all four angles and accurately record the selected angle.
- Trust-building messaging (B/D) remains a strategic preference, not an evidence-based performance conclusion.
- Legal has approved all four angles. No deliverability complaints were reported on relevant days.
- Banner/creative refreshes occurred on Day 25 and again on Days 34 and 37. Treat these as separate creative changes and avoid attributing their effects to angle alone.
- Several days had a handful of new signups, but sources are unknown; do not attribute growth to any tactic.
- Support processed multiple pairs of unsubscribes. Record each by date and send; do not infer causation without send-level data.
- For every send, record date, angle, send time, delivered/landed status, conversions, unsubscribes, creative/version changes, deliverability signals, and list changes. Preserve per-send detail in every pooled report.

Working notes:

- Campaign has run 50 pushes, generally at the usual 10am window.
- Latest pooled result: 8 of the last 10 pushes landed (+0.80), reversing the prior 2 of 10. No per-day delivery, angle, conversion, or unsubscribe breakdown is available, so the improvement cannot be diagnosed or attributed.
- Days 41–50 all used limited-time urgency (C), giving C substantially more exposure but still not proving its effectiveness without send-level outcomes.
- Earlier angle comparisons remain unbalanced: days 11–20 used testimonial (D), days 21–30 price cut (A), and days 31–40 quality story (B). Do not infer angle performance from pooled results.
- Rotate or balance all four angles in future sends and accurately record the selected angle. Trust-building messaging (B/D) remains a strategic preference, not an evidence-based performance conclusion.
- Legal has approved all four angles. No deliverability complaints were reported on relevant days.
- Banner/creative refreshes occurred on days 45, 46, 47, 48, and 50. Treat each as a separate creative change; do not attribute outcomes to angle alone.
- The list grew by a handful of signups on day 49, but the source is unknown; do not attribute growth to any tactic.
- No send-level results are available for days 41–50 beyond the pooled 8-of-10 report. Preserve per-send detail in every pooled report.
- For every send, record date, angle, send time, delivered/landed status, conversions, unsubscribes, creative/version changes, deliverability signals, and list changes. Record each unsubscribe by date and send; do not infer causation without send-level data.

Working notes:

- Campaign has run 60 pushes, generally around the usual 10am window.
- Latest pooled result: 3 of the last 10 pushes landed (+0.30), down from the prior pooled 8 of 10. No per-day delivery, angle, conversion, or unsubscribe breakdown is available; do not diagnose or attribute the change.
- Days 51–60 used only B (quality story; days 51, 54, 55, 57, 58, 60) and D (testimonial; days 52, 53, 56, 59). A and C received no exposure in this period. Rotation remains unbalanced; use balanced/randomized exposure across all four angles.
- Earlier angle comparisons remain confounded by sequential scheduling and creative changes. Do not infer angle performance from pooled results. Trust-building B/D is a strategic preference, not an evidence-based performance conclusion.
- Days 45, 46, 47, 48, and 50 had separate banner/creative refreshes. Record creative/version for every send and avoid attributing outcomes to angle alone.
- Support-reported unsubscribes were processed separately on days 51, 53, and 59. Signups occurred on days 52, 54, and 57; sources are unknown. Do not attribute unsubscribes or list growth to specific pushes.
- Legal has approved all four angles. No deliverability complaints were reported on day 58; retain deliverability signals per send.
- Days 41–60 lack send-level outcome detail beyond pooled reports. Every future report must preserve per-send data.
- For each send, record date, angle, send time, delivered/landed status, conversions, unsubscribes by date and send, creative/version changes, deliverability signals, and list changes.
